subject.title: [BUG] OpenAI Codex errors leak into user chat

question: Should this issue be resolved with top-level `detail` parser support only, or should OpenClaw also suppress/no-reply unconfigured Codex/provider failures at the routing boundary?
rationale: The parser gap is source-reproducible, but silently discarding unconfigured-provider failures changes user-visible diagnostics and provider-routing behavior.

options.title: Parser plus routing policy
options.body: Recognize `detail` payloads and add tested routing behavior so unconfigured provider failures never leak raw text while internal diagnostics remain available.

options.title: Parser-only repair
options.body: Land the narrow `detail` parser and formatter fix now, then track silent unconfigured-provider suppression separately.

options.title: Keep generic diagnostics
options.body: Decline silent discard and require provider failures to become generic safe user copy unless a maintainer later sponsors no-reply behavior.

recommendation.title: Parser plus routing policy
recommendation.body: Recognize `detail` payloads and add tested routing behavior so unconfigured provider failures never leak raw text while internal diagnostics remain available.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across OpenAI/Codex routing and shared error-delivery policy.
